title: Deus — Traces
description: Distributed tracing analytics from the deus spans (LogsQL on VictoriaTraces): service map, endpoints, where the time goes inside a request, SQL and outbox deliveries, failures, hot spots and single traces.

list.name: attribute
list.label: Hot spots by
list.query: route : span_attr:http.route,HTTP status : span_attr:http.response.status_code,pod : resource_attr:k8s.pod.name,node : resource_attr:k8s.node.name,version : resource_attr:service.version,caller : span_attr:user_agent.original

list.name: Rollouts
list.expr: (max by (namespace, replicaset, owner_name) (kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus", owner_kind="Deployment"}) unless max by (namespace, replicaset, owner_name) (kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus", owner_kind="Deployment"} offset 1m)
list.textFormat: New ReplicaSet {{replicaset}}: the pod template changed (image, env or resources)

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, target, slo, deployment) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Deus.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"})

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Server spans per second: every request handled by the selected services, /internal calls included.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats rate() rps

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of server spans answered with a 5xx.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats count() calls, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") failed | math failed*100/calls as pct_5xx | fields pct_5xx

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of the server spans.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile duration of the server spans: the slow tail behind p95. The Slowest requests table below lists those traces.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats quantile(0.99, duration) p99

panels.title: Requests slower than 1s
panels.description: Server spans that took more than one second: what users notice as slow. The Endpoints table and Where the time goes show which endpoint and why.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 duration:>1000000000 | stats count() slow

panels.title: Failed operations
panels.description: Spans with an error status, 4xx answers seen by a client excluded: 5xx, database errors, failed outbox deliveries.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" | stats count() failed

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Clients that start traces (the dashboard in the browser), the Gateway kgateway-public, every service and PostgreSQL: requests per second in the circle, p95 and the failed share below the name, successful (green) and failed (red) spans in the ring. An arrow joins a calling span to the span it caused in another service; hover it for calls per second, p95 as the caller sees it and the failed share. Client errors (4xx) do not count as failed.

targets.expr: ("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus or "resource_attr:service.namespace":=kgateway-system) (kind:=2 or kind:=4 or (kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system.name":*) or (parent_span_id:"" -kind:=2 -"span_attr:db.system.name":*)) | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as id | copy "span_attr:db.system.name" as db_system, "span_attr:server.address" as db_host | format if (kind:=3 db_system:*) "<db_system>" as id | copy id as title | format if (kind:=3 db_system:*) "<db_host> (<db_system>)" as title | stats by (id, title) rate() rps, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, count() requests, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:http.status_code":~"^4") failed | math round(p95/1e6, 0.1) as p95_ms, round(failed*100/requests, 0.01) as failed_pct | format "p95 <p95_ms> ms · <failed_pct>% failed" as subtitle | stats by (id, title, subtitle) max(rps) mainstat, max(requests) detail__requests, max(failed) detail__failed | math (detail__requests-detail__failed)/detail__requests as arc__success, detail__failed/detail__requests as arc__errors

("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus or "resource_attr:service.namespace":=kgateway-system) kind:=2 parent_span_id:* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as target | join by (trace_id, parent_span_id) (("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus or "resource_attr:service.namespace":=kgateway-system) (kind:=3 or ("resource_attr:service.namespace":=kgateway-system kind:=2)) -"span_attr:db.system.name":* | copy span_id as parent_span_id, "resource_attr:service.name" as source, duration as call_duration | fields trace_id, parent_span_id, source, call_duration) | filter source:* -source:eq_field(target) | union ("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system.name":* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as source, "span_attr:db.system.name" as target, duration as call_duration) | format "<source>→<target>" as id | stats by (id, source, target) rate() mainstat, quantile(0.95, call_duration) p95, count() detail__calls, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" -"span_attr:http.status_code":~"^4") detail__failed | math round(p95/1e6, 0.1) as detail__p95_ms, round(detail__failed*100/detail__calls, 0.01) as detail__failed_pct | delete p95

panels.title: Calls to dependencies
panels.description: Client spans by caller and callee: other services' /internal endpoints and PostgreSQL. p95 includes the network and the callee's work.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus kind:=3 | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:server.address" as peer | replace_regexp ("\\.[a-z0-9-]+\\.svc(\\.cluster\\.local)?\\.?$", "") at peer | copy "span_attr:db.system.name" as db_system, "span_attr:server.address" as db_host | format if (db_system:*) "<db_host> (<db_system>)" as peer | filter peer:* | stats by (service, peer) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") failed, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") e4, quantile(0.95, duration) p95 | sort by (calls desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Endpoints (server spans)
panels.description: Every endpoint of the selected services, the ones using the most server time first. Time share: its part of all server time (calls × duration), what to optimise first. DB share: its part spent in PostgreSQL queries of the same service. Slowest trace opens that call below; 4xx are the caller's mistakes or business rules.

value.title: Break down this endpoint (Where the time goes)

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service, name) count() calls, rate() rps, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") e5, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") e4, quantile(0.5, duration) p50, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, quantile(0.99, duration) p99, max(duration) slowest, sum(duration) total, field_max(duration, trace_id) slowest_trace, max(start_time_unix_nano) last_ns | total_stats sum(total) all_total | math round(e5*100/calls, 0.01) as pct_5xx, round(e4*100/calls, 0.01) as pct_4xx, rps*60 as rpm, round(total*100/all_total, 0.1) as time_share, round(last_ns/1e6) as last_ms | stats by (service, name, slowest_trace) max(calls) calls, max(rpm) rpm, max(pct_5xx) pct_5xx, max(pct_4xx) pct_4xx, max(p50) p50, max(p95) p95, max(p99) p99, max(slowest) slowest, max(time_share) time_share, max(last_ms) last_ms | sort by (time_share desc) | limit 100

"resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (trace_id, service, name) sum(duration) srv | join by (trace_id, service) ("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus kind:=3 "span_attr:db.system.name":=postgresql | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (trace_id, service) sum(duration) db) | stats by (service, name) sum(srv) srv, sum(db) db | math round(db*100/srv, 0.1) as db_share

panels.title: p95 by endpoint
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of each endpoint's server spans.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 | stats by (name) quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: 5xx by endpoint
panels.description: Server spans answered with a 5xx per interval, by endpoint.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5" | stats by (name) count() failed

panels.title: Operations in $endpoint traces
panels.description: Every span of the traces that went through the selected endpoint, across all services, by total time. Spans nest (a client call contains the server span it calls), so read it top-down rather than adding it up. Outbox deliveries run after the response.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus trace_id:in("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus kind:=2 name:="${endpoint:raw}" | fields trace_id) | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | format "<name>" as operation | format if (sql:*) "SQL <sql>" as operation | stats by (service, operation) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") failed, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, sum(duration) total | total_stats max(total) root_total | math round(total*100/root_total, 0.1) as time_pct, total/calls as avg | sort by (total desc) | limit 40

panels.title: p95 by operation in $endpoint traces
panels.description: A step in one operation shows where a slowdown of the endpoint comes from.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus trace_id:in("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus kind:=2 name:="${endpoint:raw}" | fields trace_id) | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | format "<name>" as operation | format if (sql:*) "SQL <sql>" as operation | stats by (service, operation) quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: Failed operations in $endpoint traces
panels.description: The operation that fails first is usually the cause; the spans above it fail because of it.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus trace_id:in("resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus kind:=2 name:="${endpoint:raw}" | fields trace_id) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | format "<name>" as operation | format if (sql:*) "SQL <sql>" as operation | stats by (service, operation) count() failed

panels.title: Database and outbox, as the services see them — $service
SQL statements
panels.description: Client-side duration of each statement: network, lock waits and execution together. Compare with Top statements in the CloudNativePG dashboard (server side only): a gap means waiting outside PostgreSQL's execution, e.g. for a connection or a lock.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) "span_attr:db.system.name":=postgresql "span_attr:db.query.text":* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:db.query.text" as sql | replace_regexp ("[ \t\n]+", " ") at sql | stats by (service, sql) count() calls, count() if (status_code:=2) failed, quantile(0.5, duration) p50, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, max(duration) slowest | sort by (p95 desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Outbox deliveries
panels.description: Producer spans of the outbox relays by destination. Each delivery continues the trace of the request that wrote the event, so a failed delivery opens on the original request.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=4 | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "span_attr:messaging.destination.name" as topic | stats by (service, topic) count() deliveries, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") failed, max("span_attr:outbox.attempts") attempts, quantile(0.95, duration) p95 | sort by (deliveries desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Outbox delivery p95 by destination
panels.description: Duration of the call to the receiving service per delivery; the delay before the delivery is in Deus — Service.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=4 | copy "span_attr:messaging.destination.name" as topic | stats by (topic) quantile(0.95, duration) p95

panels.title: Failed spans by operation
panels.description: 4xx answers seen by a client are not counted.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service, name) count() failed

panels.title: Top failure messages
panels.description: Span status messages: the exception of a 5xx, a database error or a failed delivery.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | stats by (service, name, status_message) count() failed | sort by (failed desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Latest failed spans
panels.description: Newest failed spans; expand one and use View trace (trace_id) to open the whole trace.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4" | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | math round(duration/1e6, 0.1) as ms | format "<service> <name> (<ms> ms): <status_message>" as _msg | format "error" as level

panels.title: Requests by ${attribute:text}
panels.description: Server spans grouped by the selected attribute, worst first: one route, pod, node or version standing out points to the cause.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "${attribute:raw}":* | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as service | copy "${attribute:raw}" as value | stats by (value) count() calls, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5") e5, quantile(0.95, duration) p95, max(duration) slowest | math round(e5*100/calls, 0.01) as pct_5xx | sort by (pct_5xx desc, p95 desc) | limit 30

panels.title: 5xx by ${attribute:text}
panels.description: Requests answered with a 5xx per interval, split by the attribute chosen in Hot spots by: whether failures concentrate on one route, pod, node or version.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":in($service) kind:=2 "${attribute:raw}":* "span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^5" | copy "${attribute:raw}" as value | stats by (value) count() failed

panels.title: Invoice issue outcomes
panels.description: What users got when issuing an invoice: 200 issued, 409 already issued, 422 rejected by a business rule (inactive customer, closed period), 5xx failures.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":=sales kind:=2 name:="POST /api/sales/invoices/:id/issue" | copy "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as code | stats by (code) count() requests

panels.title: Payment outcomes
panels.description: Receipts and vendor payments: 201 recorded, 400 invalid input, 422 an allocation larger than the amount due.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus "resource_attr:service.name":=payments kind:=2 name:="POST /api/payments/" | copy "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as code | stats by (code) count() requests

panels.title: Traces
panels.description: One row per trace, newest first, like a trace search: the root is the page the user opened in the browser (pageload or navigation, with its API requests below), or the first API request when the caller is not traced (k6). Click the root or the trace ID to open the trace in Explore: the waterfall from the browser through the gateway to the services and the database, with links to each span's logs and metrics. Filter with Service, Trace duration over and Traces, or with the column filters.

targets.expr: "resource_attr:service.namespace":=deus | copy "resource_attr:service.name" as svc | stats by (trace_id) min(start_time_unix_nano) started_ns, max(end_time_unix_nano) ended_ns, field_min(start_time_unix_nano, svc) if (parent_span_id:="" or kind:=2) service, field_min(start_time_unix_nano, name) if (parent_span_id:="" or kind:=2) root, count() spans, count_uniq(svc) services, count() if (status_code:=2 -"span_attr:http.response.status_code":~"^4") errors, count() if ("resource_attr:service.name":in($service)) touched | math round(started_ns/1e6) as started_ms, ended_ns-started_ns as took | filter touched:>0 took:>=${min_duration:raw} errors:>=${failed:raw} | stats by (trace_id, service, root) max(started_ms) started_ms, max(took) took, max(spans) spans, max(services) services, max(errors) errors | sort by (started_ms desc) | limit 200
